Example single-cell RNA-seq dataset (simulated)

Source: R/data.R
example_sce.Rd

A small, simulated SingleCellExperiment::SingleCellExperiment provided as a ready-to-use example for the dittoSeq-based modules (dittoDimPlotServer(), dittoScatterPlotServer(), dittoPlotServer(), dittoBarPlotServer(), dittoDimHexServer(), dittoFreqPlotServer(), and dittoRidgeJitterServer()).

Usage

data(example_sce)

Format

A SingleCellExperiment::SingleCellExperiment with 40 genes and 240 cells containing:

assays

counts and logcounts

reducedDims

PCA, TSNE, and UMAP embeddings

colData

clustering, celltype, condition, and sample (discrete), plus nCount and percent.mito (continuous)

Source

Simulated in data-raw/generate_example_sce.R; no real biological data are included.

Author

Jacob Martin

Examples

library(sciVizModules)
data(example_sce)
example_sce
#> class: SingleCellExperiment 
#> dim: 40 240 
#> metadata(0):
#> assays(2): counts logcounts
#> rownames(40): Gene1 Gene2 ... Gene39 Gene40
#> rowData names(0):
#> colnames(240): Cell1 Cell2 ... Cell239 Cell240
#> colData names(6): clustering celltype ... nCount percent.mito
#> reducedDimNames(3): PCA TSNE UMAP
#> mainExpName: NULL
#> altExpNames(0):
